claims.text: DevOps, as team-structure.md applies it, is a way of working in which the people who build a service also deploy it, watch it and answer for it in production, instead of handing it to a separate operations group.
claims.source_hint: outline item 1; docs/team/team-structure.md @ stage-4 lines 88-90 (definition anchored to the project file; no docs root in versions.yaml)

claims.text: A separate 'DevOps team' that deploys and watches everyone's services is a separate operations group: changes queue at it, pages go to people who did not write the code, and product teams learn how their code behaves in production only second-hand.

team-structure.md lines 87-90: each stream-aligned team keeps SLOs, alerts, runbooks and on-call for its own services (slo.md, alerts.md, docs/runbooks/); the person who writes a service also deploys, watches and answers for it in production; no separate team takes deploys and watching for others.

team-structure.md lines 91-93: the platform team runs and is on call for the cluster and shared tools; because it holds the shared part, stream-aligned teams deploy through the golden path instead of each learning the cluster to the bottom.
team-structure.md lines 94-96: until the new teams form, one team builds and runs everything, so on-call.md has one shared rotation; sustainable rotations are in on-call-staffing.md.

on-call.md (outside excerpt): the rotation is the team's four developers with one-week shifts; product owner, scrum master and tester are not in it; it is a plan, not yet live (no notifier, no Prometheus in production).

ADR 0025 lines 66-73: platform forms first, today's team becomes Đặt hàng, then Cửa hàng forms; on-call splits by team when the new teams form (stream-aligned teams for their services, platform for cluster and shared tools); until then on-call.md keeps one rotation.
In the plan Đặt hàng owns the Ordering module, Payments and Notifications; Cửa hàng owns the Catalog module; the platform team owns Argo CD, Prometheus and other shared tools.
claims.source_hint: docs/team/team-structure.md @ stage-4 lines 46-48 (plan table); used in sections 7 and 9

claims.text: The platform team publishes a route for requests: an issue with the platform team's label.
claims.source_hint: docs/team/team-structure.md @ stage-4 line 77 (table 'Mỗi đội cung cấp gì')

claims.text: on-call.md's review after each shift lowers a page that needed no action to `ticket` or removes it.
claims.source_hint: docs/team/on-call.md @ stage-4 section 'Xem lại mọi lần gọi'

claims.text: DonHang.Api holds both the Ordering module and Catalog; slo.md measures S1-S4 (order and product requests) on DonHang.Api; team-structure.md does not say which team's on-call takes the api's alerts after the split.
claims.source_hint: docs/team/team-structure.md @ stage-4 table 'Đội hôm nay' row api and whole file; docs/design/slo.md @ stage-4 lines 1-8

claims.text: Trade-offs: build-and-run with a platform team fits several teams sharing one cluster; a separate operations group adds a queue and moves learning away; each team running its own cluster has a high load; one team running all fits only before a split.

Choices not recorded in the files (hedged): keep on-call with Đặt hàng and fix runbooks or the golden path; do not move every night page to the platform team; settle the api's on-call in writing before paging goes live, e.g. SLI by SLI.
claims.source_hint: team-structure.md lines 77, 87-93; on-call.md review section; misconceptions 2-3

claims.text: Possible symptoms (hedged): requests to 'DevOps' for each release; an on-call person outside the team can only restart and wait; the platform issue list fills with requests to deploy others' changes.

beyond_scope: Section 7 notes that team-structure.md leaves open which team is on call for the shared DonHang.Api; stated as a gap, not resolved.
